Professional Leak Detection in Olmos Park

Although they happen frequently, plumbing leaks don’t always have to be a major issue. Water damage can be avoided provided the leak is found and fixed promptly. The issue is that finding certain leaks can be very challenging, particularly if they are hidden under floors or behind walls.
If a leak is not fixed, it can cause problems including mildew, mold and odors. Severe structural damage may occasionally result, which can be very expensive to put right.

There are numerous indicators of a leak that you should watch out for. For example, a leak may be the cause of persistently foul smells in your house. Discolored walls may indicate that water is seeping into them. Additionally, listen for any sounds of water dripping or trickling behind the walls.

It’s always advisable to schedule water leak detection with a licensed plumber if you see any of these indicators. When it comes to handling leaks, it’s always better to be safe than sorry, so don’t wait to contact our experienced team for assistance!
